stem.text: Which epithelial junction provides a passage for small molecules and ions between the cytoplasm of adjacent cells?

key_explanation.text: Option A, a tight junction, provides intercellular channels for small molecules and ions, allowing neighboring cells to communicate directly.

strongest_distractor.text: B is the strongest distractor: a tight junction restricts movement between cells rather than connecting their cytoplasm. C, a desmosome, mechanically links neighboring cells; D, a plasmodesma, is a plant-cell channel rather than an epithelial junction in animal tissue. None of these is the animal-cell gap-junction channel described in the stem.
